method.mainComponent: union-find over enabled walk/door/opening/ramp/elevator/escalator/local-steps/stairs edges of graph-full.json; main = component with most arrival nodes
method.roomMatch: names[] matched to graph-full records by (number, name) within the floor levels; duplicates resolved by nearest arrival node to the label point (all 1,855 names matched)
method.drawnReached: a net line ends at arrival:<roomKey> (netNodes) OR any net line passes within 15 dm of the label point
method.faint: net category 2/3 is drawn at 45% alpha, 1.1 px (index.html line 293); category 1 is gray --walk 1.1 px

Undrawn: 19 short openings (0.27-1.18 m; mostly opening:recovered-front, absent from the preview pathConnections the seams came from) and 34 door crossings whose portal sits >0.3 m (max 0.59 m) outside the drawn footprint. Neither changes topology much; the perceived disconnections come from faint category-3 lines and gray category-1 lines.

verified: No door footprint of any state lies between 08-202 Corridor and 08-249 Office. Their outlines come within 1.44 ft (0.44 m) at about (-128,247) dm, but they are separate native cells (08-202 in cell 616, 08-249 in cell 671), with no door or opening between them.

Nearest doors: 2463553 (connected, owners 08-247 Print and 08-202 Corridor), the door at the east end of 08-202, centre (-134,260), 3.0 ft from the 08-249 outline. Stepping 0.25-2 ft off its inner face lands inside 08-247 Print, and 08-249 is 4.5 ft away. 2463309 (unmatched, no owners, one-side, a 0.38 ft x 0.98 ft sliver at (-135,266)) opens only into 08-203 Womens Washroom cell 661.

Native cell 671 holds 10 rooms (08-240 Corridor, 08-239, 08-242, 08-243, 08-244, 08-245, 08-246, 08-247, 08-248, 08-249). Walks 1115, 1113 and 1107 run between them without crossing any native wall footprint, so the Revit model has no wall between 08-247 Print, 08-245 Storage and 08-249.

Routing today: 08-202 arrival, walk 506, walk 478 (hallway guide to the 08-202-side portal of door 2463553 at (-139,258)), door 2463553, then walk 1115 (cat 3, faint) from (-129,261) via (-94,271) and (-87,246) to the 08-249 arrival at (-88,247). Total 56.7 ft. This route already ends at the end of 08-202; it is not via 08-246 or 08-248.
Without door 2463553 the next route is 139.8 ft, through door 1995259 (08-202 to 08-240 Corridor) and the open cell 671 floor (08-245 Storage).

08-249 has 5 enabled walks: to its doors 1996013 (to 08-248) and 1995965 (to 08-246), to the 08-245 and 08-247 arrivals, and to door 2463553:0. 08-246 and 08-248 have no other door, so they are reached only through 08-249, not the other way round.

Drawn: the 08-202 hallway (cat 0, solid) stops at door 2463553. Everything past it (1115, 1105, 1113, 1094, 1102, 1089) is cat 3, drawn at 45% alpha and 1.1 px. 1115 doglegs 3.6 m east and then 2.6 m back south and west, so the 08-249 connection reads as missing. Walk 478 also has a small sawtooth at (-146,253), (-142,260), (-142,257), (-139,258).
whatWouldConnectIt: Display only (no rebuild): draw walk 1115 door:694:2463553:0 -> arrival:rm-694-44498dfee60e in the hallway style, or as a straight segment (-129,261) -> (-88,247). This line stays inside cell 671 and crosses no wall footprint (verified for the existing polyline; inferred for the straight one).

If in reality door 2463553 opens into 08-249 rather than 08-247 Print, its owners need a door-owner review (08-247 -> 08-249) and the native rebuild. The model face test says 08-247, so this is an owner decision.
There is no door footprint to pair. A direct 08-202 -> 08-249 doorway would need a drawn-door patch and the rebuild. Unverified that one exists on site.

verified: Unmatched doors 1512930 (centre (-371,328), north wall of the Link) and 1512831 (centre (-362,298), south wall). Both are 0.21 ft thick and about 5.8 ft wide, native-door-sides kind one-side. Side A is cell 589 (08-260 Link only); side B has no native cell. Stepping 0.25-2 ft outward lands in no room on level 694, and the nearest rooms (08-214 Office, 08-216 Vestibule) are 16.6-18.7 ft away. They lead out of the Link to no modelled space. They are probably exterior or glazed doors on the bridge sides (inferred). They are not missing interior connections.

Door 2311764 (connected, 08-216 Vestibule <-> 08-260 Link) is drawn: footprint, link line (-314,332)->(-324,329), Link-side walk 312 (cat 0) arrival->(-376,310)->(-337,322)->(-330,335)->(-324,329), and 08-216-side walks 493 and 494 (cat 0).

So 08-260 is drawn connected end to end: 04-204 - [1609857] - gray 313 - Link arrival - 312 - [2311764] - 08-216. Its label (-436,295) is 6.6 m from its arrival (-372,311). The only weak spot is the gray, unsimplified 17.8 m leg 313.
